exposure: Integration of fine-tuned large language models (MedGPT) into the ObsCare obstetric electronic health record system
outcome: Summarization of a pregnant patient's health journey
Addressing critical gaps in obstetric care (workforce shortages, increasing C-section rates, rising maternal age)
cohort: The project is designed for clinicians and pregnant patients using the ObsCare electronic health record system in Portuguese hospitals.
finding: This work-in-progress describes the planned architecture, data sources, and early implementation strategies for integrating fine-tuned large language models (MedGPT) into ObsCare, aiming to summarize patient health journeys, provide decision support, generate educational content, and reduce documentation burden.
